start: Signed in as the owner; internet on; member page with a receipt for a running membership

steps.action: In the Payments card tap "Cancel receipt" on the receipt
user_sees: Sheet titled "Cancel this receipt?"

"Receipt <number> for <amount>, taken on <day>, will no longer count as money received. The amount is added back to this member’s dues. The receipt stays in the list, marked cancelled. Its number is never used again."
Box "Reason" (example "Entered twice") with "Saved with the receipt, so it is clear months later."
Buttons "Keep it" and "Cancel receipt" (greyed)
must_not: The receipt cancelled by the first tap

user_sees: Button reads "Cancelling…"
Sheet closes
Toast "Receipt cancelled. The amount is back in their dues."
must_not: The amount still counted as money received

user_sees: The receipt stays, amount struck through, with "Cancelled: <reason>"
Dues tile up by the amount; "Collect payment" shows
No "Cancel receipt" button on that receipt any more
must_not: The receipt number given to a new receipt

start: Signed in as the owner; member page with a receipt on a membership that was cancelled

user_sees: "That membership is cancelled, so nothing is added back to their dues."
must_not: A promise that the amount goes back to dues

user_sees: Toast "Receipt cancelled." (no words about dues)
Dues tile unchanged
must_not: Dues going up for a cancelled membership

start: Signed in as the owner; "Cancel this receipt?" sheet open

steps.action: Type a reason that is too short
user_sees: "Cancel receipt" stays greyed
must_not: A receipt cancelled with no reason

user_sees: Sheet closes; the receipt counts as before

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the Payments card
user_sees: "Cancel receipt" is greyed and says it needs internet
must_not: A cancel kept only on this device

steps.action: Sign in as front desk staff and open the same page
user_sees: No "Cancel receipt" on any receipt

start: Signed in as the owner; member page with a receipt cancelled earlier

user_sees: The page to print still opens for it
must_not: A cancelled receipt printing like a good one with no mark

steps.action: Look for a way to bring it back
user_sees: No undo; the money is taken again with "Collect payment", which makes a new receipt number

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; a receipt cancelled with a reason

steps.action: Check who could do this and where the reason shows
user_sees: Only the owner had the button
The reason under the receipt on the gym's own pages
must_not: A staff login able to cancel a receipt
The reason or the cancelled receipt readable by another gym
The cancel leaving no trace of who did it and why
